execution_script:
set -eu
source_dir=/work/linux-focused-publication-20260921-1823
if test -e "$source_dir/go.mod"; then echo 'Refusing to overwrite source snapshot'; exit 2; fi
mkdir -p "$source_dir"
tar -xf /work/linux-focused-publication-20260921-1823.tar -C "$source_dir"
cd "$source_dir"
export GOMAXPROCS=2
export CGO_ENABLED=1
go version
go test -race ./internal/store ./internal/observer ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli -run '^TestObservation|^TestDerivedPublication_V6_|^TestDeliveryTerminal_|^TestFsck_UnknownObservationIntent|^TestCarriedDefect_SP08D2_' -count=1 -timeout=5m -v
coverage: Focused in-process Go race instrumentation of store, observer, daemon and CLI. No installed Claude host, child product process, human UAT or final candidate certification.
provenance: The wrapper run records Windows workspace hashes. The executed Linux source is the isolated archive named here; later workspace edits cannot certify this snapshot.
